risk_yaml:
_forge_version: 5.1.0
inputs:
  revenue: 96221
  cost_of_revenue: 24079
  operating_expenses: 8408
  net_income: 59688
outputs:
  gross_profit:
    formula: =inputs.revenue - inputs.cost_of_revenue
  operating_income:
    formula: =outputs.gross_profit - inputs.operating_expenses
  gross_margin:
    formula: =outputs.gross_profit / inputs.revenue
  operating_margin:
    formula: =outputs.operating_income / inputs.revenue
  net_margin:
    formula: =inputs.net_income / inputs.revenue
tornado:
  output: outputs.operating_income
  inputs:
  - name: inputs.revenue
    low: 86598.9
    high: 105843.1
  - name: inputs.cost_of_revenue
    low: 21671.1
    high: 26486.9
  - name: inputs.operating_expenses
    low: 7567.2
    high: 9248.8
  - name: inputs.net_income
    low: 53719.2
    high: 65656.8
assumptions: Each numeric input varied by 10% (tornado: low/high; Monte Carlo: normal with std dev 10% of the value, independent draws).
